read.en: Corning was little changed (−0.1%) on Nov 2 at $123.20, trading between $122.37 and $128.23. It is below the falling 5-day ($126.6), 10-day ($127.6), 30-day ($144.3) and 100-day ($160.7) averages and the rising 200-day ($155.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($132.58), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 康宁 11月2日基本持平（−0.1%），收于 $123.20，盘中区间 $122.37–128.23。股价位于下行的 5 日（$126.6）、10 日（$127.6）、30 日（$144.3）和 100 日均线（$160.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$155.8）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄、趋近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$132.58），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The session reached $128.2 but faded below the 10-day; the $121.8–122.8 support held again at a $122.37 low, and no written level broke. Resistance is $125.4–126.7 (5-day, Oct 28 low, Oct 30 high), then $127.6–128.6 (10-day, recent highs) and $132.6–133.2 (SAR, Oct 28–29 highs). Support is $121.8–122.8, then $120.0–120.5 and $114.0–114.5. A close above $128.6 would target $132.6; below $121.8, $120.
